7356.title: Partial vacuum progress is omitted after contention
7356.rootCauseOneLine: A later SQLite busy error escapes the chunk loop before saved progress reaches the sweep logger.
7356.proposedFix: Return an interrupted outcome with completed chunk statistics and log it once without a completion message.
7356.caveats: Regression source and verbatim evidence are embedded inline; raw artifacts remain local under report repository policy.
